source: Plan of the Yuanmingyuan Imperial Garden-Palace, Princeton University Art Museum 2022-27 a-c
pixel_frame: plan_x, plan_y: pixels on the mosaic, origin top-left
datum: control and check points WGS84 (EPSG:4326); fitted in UTM 50N (EPSG:32650)
method: Thin-plate spline on the control points of Round 1 and Round 8, with its smoothing set per region by leave-one-out; scored on the blind check set frozen before any fit (check_points.json); in a region where it does worse than the Round 1 fit there, a grid of points every 50 m taken from the Round 1 fit holds the spline to it.

YM-west.note: Yuan Ming Yuan west of the nine islands: the plain of 山高水长, 安佑宫, the west wall. The plan is schematic here (Q8) and many ponds were dug or filled after 1950.

YM-east.note: Yuan Ming Yuan from the nine islands round 后湖 to 福海's west shore scenes: 前湖, the 正大光明 axis, 舍卫城.

YM-fuhai.note: 福海 and its shore scenes, up to the wall with Changchun Yuan.

CC.note: Changchun Yuan without the Xiyang Lou strip: its lakes, 含经堂, the south and east walls.

XYL.note: The Xiyang Lou strip on Changchun Yuan's north edge; ruins read on today's imagery.

QC.note: Qichun Yuan; its lakes were re-dug in modern times.
